thread:
marta: spun up a small canary of atlas-int6 on tooling flows. Seeing a new failure class: function call JSON with complete payload but missing the final closing brace in streaming responses. non-streaming looks clean in quick replay.

kevin: repro from logs:
```
{"fn":"create_issue","params":{"title":"Payment error","user":321, "meta":{...}}
...<cut>
```
parser: unexpected EOF, expected '}'

ada: is this only on larger payloads? anything correlated with array fields or nested objects?

marta: mostly nested objects and payloads > 180 tokens. batch size 6 for the canary, streaming on.

syl: could be streamer flush losing the last chunk on preempt or a stray duplicate-EOS confusing the state machine. Check worker preempt and eos_count.

kevin: metric snapshot: slight bump in preempt during the window and a few double-EOS occurrences. flipping 20% of canary to sync-mode now to verify streaming-only hypothesis.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy atlas-int6 -> 2026-05-02T10:21:00Z (id: 9a7b3)

marta: short-term mitigations: 1) enable client-side "close-brace-heal" for canary only (append missing braces if balanced), 2) allow one internal sync retry on parse-fail for long responses (no user quota charge), 3) capture masked last-8 tokens for failed parses. We'll log repairs separately.

ada: +1. also add metric last_chunk_arrival_delta and repair_heal_rate. If heal_rate > 0.5% vs baseline we alert and rollback.

syl: if sync-mode removes failures that's strong indicator of streaming final-chunk loss. Next: ensure streamer acknowledges final-chunk persist or add explicit end-sentinel. If kernel alignment is also involved, microquant rebuild may be needed.

marta: running a 3k-prompt replay across float/int8/int6 with streaming for 45m. will post structured-output diffs and repair counts when done. keeping the canary tight. :mag:
